profile.reading:
This OpenStreetMap point is labeled "Microsoft" and tagged telecom=data_center at an address in Guaynabo, Puerto Rico, but a prior research pass this project ran and this session's own follow-up both found no evidence this is an actual data center rather than a Microsoft Caribbean Inc. regional business or sales office. Directory listings for Microsoft's Guaynabo presence variously describe it as a "Business Center" or a general Microsoft Caribbean corporate location, categorized under software rather than data infrastructure, and no listing found describes server halls, IT capacity, or colocation services at the address. Puerto Rico Data Center Map, a third-party tracker that lists three data center facilities across the territory, does not include a Microsoft-operated facility among them, which further weighs against this being a genuine hyperscale or colocation data center. Puerto Rico does host real, well-documented data center activity from other operators, so the absence of a Microsoft listing there is a meaningful negative signal rather than simply an information gap. Given this evidence, this registry treats this point as most likely representing a Microsoft regional sales or support office that was mistagged as a data center in OpenStreetMap, rather than assigning it fabricated address-confirmation, square footage, or capacity figures it cannot support with a real source.

Microsoft's own published Azure region list does not name Puerto Rico among its data center regions or availability zones anywhere in the Americas outside the continental United States, Canada, and Brazil, which is consistent with this address being a corporate or sales presence rather than cloud infrastructure. This registry has found no county or municipal permit record, utility interconnection filing, or trade press coverage describing a Microsoft-built or Microsoft-leased data center anywhere in Guaynabo, further supporting the mistagged-office interpretation over the alternative that a genuine, simply undocumented facility exists here.

reading.body:
This address in Guaynabo is tagged as a Microsoft data center in OpenStreetMap but carries no published IT capacity figures. Research found no evidence of server infrastructure, colocation services, utility interconnection filings, or municipal permits at this location. Directory listings describe it as a Microsoft Caribbean regional business or sales office categorized under software services rather than data infrastructure.

Microsoft's published Azure region list does not name Puerto Rico as a data center location anywhere in the Americas. Puerto Rico Data Center Map, a third-party tracker of the territory's facilities, does not list any Microsoft-operated data center there, and no trade press coverage describes Microsoft-built or leased infrastructure at this address. The weight of negative evidence suggests this point was mistagged in OpenStreetMap rather than representing an undocumented facility.

This registry cannot assign capacity figures to a location with no published specification and no confirmed infrastructure. No meaningful statement about AI scaling capacity can be drawn from a corporate office address. Any update to this entry would require confirmation through municipal property records or utility filings showing actual data center operations at this Guaynabo location.
